_meta.purpose: Structured, machine-verifiable RETRACTION TRAIL. Each entry records a WITHDRAWN overclaim, WHY it was wrong, the CORRECTED claim, and -- where reproduced=true -- a lightweight check (in verify_corrections.py) that re-derives the reversal so it stays verifiable. Pattern borrowed from the sibling T1D repo's `v1-withdrawn` correction-trail claim: the old result is kept reproducible precisely so the reversal cannot quietly disappear. The correction trail IS the credibility.
_meta.audit_trail: AUDIT.md (P1 self-audit), AUDIT2.md (multi-agent re-audit of P2-P16), AUDIT3.md (contested-biology review). This file structures the numeric/headline reversals from those.
_meta.honest_note: reproduced=false entries are framing/citation corrections (no single number to re-derive); they are documented here, not machine-checked. reproduced=true entries carry the 'reversal stays verifiable' property.

corrections.why_wrong: 0.134 = 1/7.5 was a LOCAL fit at the invasion threshold; the TIP transmission cycle is two-stage (Vt->Id->Vt), so its next-generation spectral radius is a GEOMETRIC mean -> sub-linear.
corrections.check: the linear 0.134*psi predicts R0_TIP(20)=2.68; the NGM gives ~1.63 (= sqrt(20/7.5)). The linear claim over-predicts by >60% at high psi; sqrt(psi) matches. -> the withdrawn scaling is reproducibly wrong.

corrections.withdrawn: a TIP is NEUTRAL / ORTHOGONAL to the immune-mediated cure
corrections.why_wrong: a DECOUPLING ARTIFACT: the reservoir and the TIP were modeled as non-interacting (chi=0), so a reactivating provirus never transited a TIP-accessible co-infected state -> the TIP had no substrate where the cure succeeds. The model encoded non-interaction, then reported it as a finding (AUDIT2 #2).
corrections.corrected: a reservoir-COUPLED TIP (chi>0) HELPS post-treatment control; chi=0 recovers the de Boer 'neutral' limit (P11/P14)
corrections.check: from the committed coupling grid (p14_coupling_phase.npz), the TIP effect is ~0 at chi=0 (the withdrawn 'neutral' verdict holds ONLY there) and clearly positive at chi=1 (the correction). The neutral headline was a chi=0 artifact.

corrections.why_wrong: the global coupling grid shows occasional <=1-pt NEGATIVE nudges within stochastic noise; the absolute 'never' / 'orthogonal' rounded a small negative to zero (AUDIT2 #11). Also the control metric can only show the TIP pushing OVER threshold (AUDIT2 #13).
corrections.corrected: NO SYSTEMATIC backfire: Delta(chi) >= 0, with <=1-pt nudges within noise (softened in the v2 manuscript)
corrections.check: the committed coupling grid min effect is a small negative within noise (>= -2 pts) and never a systematic harm -> 'no systematic backfire' holds; the absolute 'never' was imprecise.

corrections.withdrawn: the leading cure paradigm is immune (notably CD8 / 'vaccinal-effect') control of the reservoir
corrections.why_wrong: post-treatment-control mechanism is MULTIFACTORIAL and unresolved; the canonical spontaneous-PTC cohort (VISCONTI) controls with WEAK CD8 (reservoir size + NK + humoral all implicated). The framing stated a contested premise as settled (AUDIT3 F1).
corrections.corrected: kappa read EFFECTOR-AGNOSTIC (CD8 and/or NK/ADCC); PTC mechanism multifactorial -- a deliberate generalization that fits the literature and keeps the result independent of which effector dominates
corrections.check: framing/citation correction -- no single number to re-derive; verified by literature (Mesquita & Li 2024; Passaes 2024) and propagated through the v2 spread.

corrections.withdrawn: Pitchai et al. (Science 2024) showed the TIP 'suppressed HIV rebound after interruption of ART' in NHPs
corrections.why_wrong: the NHP study included NO in-vivo ART-interruption arm; that phrasing conflated an IN-VITRO latency-reversal result with an in-vivo ATI finding (verified by full-text read, 2026-06-23).
corrections.corrected: kept the verbatim immune-response quote; added the in-vitro co-reactivation as a non-clinical hint; stated 'no in-vivo ATI arm' explicitly
corrections.check: citation-accuracy correction -- documented, fixed in the v2 manuscript intro.
